Questions, answered

Budgets, timelines and design process: the things clients ask first.

Where do you work?

We are based in Kalyani, West Bengal. Share your location and we will confirm how we can support your project.

Can I see my design before work starts?

Yes. We offer 2D and 3D design so you can review layouts and materials first.

Do you design kitchens and wardrobes?

Yes, modular kitchens, bedrooms and wardrobes are part of our home interiors.

Do you take commercial projects?

Yes, including cafes, shops and other commercial interiors.

How do I get a quote?

Send your details through the form below or on WhatsApp. We will reply to discuss the next step.
